result.title: PreserveReward: Reliable Consistency Reward Modeling for Image Editing via Dual-Teacher On-Policy Self-Distillation
result.summary: Instruction-guided image editing has a wide range of applications, yet existing models may inadvertently alter content that should remain unchanged. Reliable consistency evaluation is therefore essential for assessing content preservation and providing reward signals for Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, existing reward models may overlook subtle visual changes or fail to distinguish necessary modifications from unintended alterations, limiting the reliability of consistency assessment. To address this challenge, we propose PreserveReward, a consistency reward model for image editing that integrates visual On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) to enhance fine-grained visual perception and consistency assessment. PreserveReward learns from reference preservation scores through a regression-based scoring loss and employs two complementary teacher views for self-distillation. The local teacher uses matched crops to identify subtle visual changes, while the joint teacher combines local details with global context to determine whether these changes align with the editing intent. To improve the reliability of distillation supervision, we calibrate teacher score distributions via minimum-KL projection under reference-score error constraints and adaptively select teacher process supervision based on gradient alignment with the scoring objective, mitigating scoring bias and optimization conflicts. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PreserveReward achieves strong alignment with human preference on non-edited content preservation and generalizes well across diverse editing scenarios.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向指令式图像编辑的一致性奖励模型 PreserveReward，用局部裁剪教师与全局联合教师做 on-policy 自蒸馏，并以梯度对齐筛选过程监督、校准教师分数分布，以提升对细微视觉变化与「应保持不变内容」的评分可靠性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按梯度对齐自适应选择教师监督、缓解监督偏差与优化冲突的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹训练中的贡献分配与监督可靠性提供方法线索，但原文不涉及 VLM 推理期状态生成，仅供核查。
